sentences.text: Bd. Mr. Soumya Nag  Mr. Ramendu Agarwal
Ms. Apoorva Choudhury ... for the petitioners.
Mr. Anirban Dutta  Mr. Apalak Basu  Mr. Abhishek Jain ... for the

This is an application wherein petitioner has prayed for quashing of a proceeding being GR (S) Case No. 209 of 2023 pending before learned Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Calcutta, under sections 120B/406/465/467/468/471 and 420 of the IPC.

It is submitted by the parties that petitioner no. 1 and 3 had on earlier occasion approached this Hon'ble Court seeking quashing of the instant proceeding by filing the application under section 482 read with section 401 of the Cr.P.C. being 1497 of 2023 and by judgment dated 19th June, 2023 this High Court was pleased to dismiss the said application.
Therefore the petitioners and the defacto-complainant have amicably settled their private disputes and in terms of settlement the defacto-complainant does not want to proceed further with the instant Application and to that extent they are seeking leave to file connected Application.
Having heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned counsel for the opposite party no.
2, leave to file the connected application is granted, which shall be filed within a period of one week.

Petitioners shall serve copy of the application along with connected application to the State through the office of the Public Prosecutor, High Court Calcutta.
Let the matter be listed on 16th February, 2026.

(Dr. Ajoy Kumar Mukherjee, J.)
